title: Update backend Callaway chart to match the provided 13×11 dataset

requirements.text: Replace the hard-coded backend Callaway chart in `backend/main.mo` (currently returned by `getBackendChart()`) with the user-provided 13-row dataset so that production calculations and chart values match the exact provided grossScore→holesToDeduct pairs (including 0.5 increments and placeholder cells with grossScore=0 / worstHoles=0).
acceptanceCriteria: `getBackendChart()` no longer returns the legacy long list starting at lowerBound 69; it is replaced by logic/data that exactly matches the provided 13-row table values (Row 1 through Row 13) as captured in `feature_evidence.json`.

For each gross score explicitly present in the provided dataset (72 through 130, plus placeholders), the backend’s deduction-holes lookup uses the exact `worstHoles` value from the dataset (e.g., 73→0.5, 91→3, 92→2.5, 116→5.5, 126→5.5, 127→6, etc.).
Backend calculation continues to support half-hole deductions (0.5) without rounding the hole count.

requirements.text: Update backend chart exposure and lookup so that `getCallawayChart()` returns correct ranges and values for the updated chart, and scoring uses the same updated chart semantics (i.e., range-based matching rather than the current `grossScoreTo = lowerBound + 4` heuristic if it does not reflect the real chart groups).
acceptanceCriteria: Calling `getCallawayChart()` returns a coherent set of `SharedChartEntry` records whose `grossScoreFrom/grossScoreTo`, `deduction`, and `adjustment` values align with the provided dataset and do not fabricate ranges via `lowerBound + 4` when that would be inaccurate.

For a set of representative gross scores that exist in the provided dataset (e.g., 72, 73, 80, 92, 98, 105, 116, 121, 126, 130), `calculateCallaway(...)` selects a chart entry that yields the exact corresponding deduction holes and adjustment implied by the chart exposed via `getCallawayChart()`.

requirements.text: Align or remove the backend `getGrossToDeductionTable()` output so it is consistent with the updated backend chart data (no stale ranges/values that contradict the chart used by `calculateCallaway`).
acceptanceCriteria: `getGrossToDeductionTable()` no longer returns ranges/values that conflict with the backend chart used for scoring; the returned tuples are updated to match the new chart logic or the endpoint is adjusted so it cannot mislead clients with outdated data.
If the endpoint remains, its tuples reflect the updated deductions and adjustments used by backend scoring for the gross-score domain covered by the provided dataset.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).

Do not edit files in frontend immutable paths: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and anything under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Do not introduce external databases or third-party backend services.
Do not redesign the frontend UI; focus only on making production chart values match the provided dataset by fixing the backend source of truth.
